jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Strategy
jobs.description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Senior Manager, Strategy plays a key role in supporting and driving cross-functional strategies that align with organizational goals and deliver profitable growth. In this role, they lead analytical efforts, provide insights to inform decision-making, and assist with developing strategic narratives for senior stakeholders. They collaborate with cross-functional teams, acting as a connector to identify opportunities and align initiatives with enterprise objectives.

What You Will Do

Analytical Leadership:

- Lead research and analysis efforts to support strategic initiatives.

- Apply structured problem-solving frameworks to develop actionable recommendations for business challenges.

Strategic Narrative Development:

- Create and refine presentations and documents that clearly communicate strategic recommendations to senior leaders and the board.

- Ensure all materials are backed by strong data and insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

- Partner with senior leaders and teams across functions to identify synergies and opportunities for alignment.

- Act as a connector between teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring consistency in strategic execution.

Initiative Tracking & Reporting:

- Monitor the progress of strategic initiatives, gather feedback, and refine strategies to improve execution.

Change Agent Support:

- Support senior leaders in driving organizational change by helping to influence and align stakeholders.

Mentorship & Development:

- Mentor team members and take responsibility for the development and onboarding of new team members.

- Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

- In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Strong Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to conduct research, analyze data, and develop actionable insights.

Effective Communication: Skilled in crafting clear, compelling narratives and presenting complex ideas to diverse audiences, including executives and the board.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across teams and functions to align initiatives and achieve organizational goals.

Problem-Solving Capabilities: Ability to apply structured methodologies to identify solutions and resolve complex challenges.

Leadership Skills: Capacity to guide team members, support their development, and lead efforts to influence and align stakeholders.

Project Management Proficiency: Experience managing multiple priorities and projects, with a focus on execution and timely results.

Professional Growth Mindset:  Eager to develop skills and expand professional expertise, with opportunities to advance into future leadership roles.

Who You Are

- Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. MBA preferred.

- 3-6 years of experience in strategy, consulting, or a related field.

- This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

- Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Operations
jobs.description:
Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for a highly automated, large-scale Direct-to-Consumer Customer Fulfillment Center operating in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

This leader is responsible for driving end-to-end operational performance across receiving, inventory, fulfillment, packing, sortation, and shipping while delivering results in customer service, productivity, cost, quality, inventory accuracy, safety, and colleague engagement.

Working closely with the Facility Leader and cross-functional partners, this role optimizes the interaction between people, process, automation, technology, and capacity to ensure total-building performance. The Senior Director serves as a key member of the facility leadership team and may lead the facility in the absence of the Facility Leader.

The ideal candidate combines deep fulfillment expertise, automation experience, strong business acumen, and proven success leading large organizations through leaders in complex, multi-shift environments.

What You Will Do

- Lead end-to-end fulfillment operations across all shifts, ensuring strong execution, customer service, and operational performance throughout the fulfillment process.

- Develop and lead a high-performing organization through Directors, Managers, and frontline leaders, establishing a culture of accountability, ownership, engagement, and continuous improvement.

- Drive performance against productivity, throughput, service, quality, inventory, safety, reliability, labor, and financial objectives.

- Optimize operational flow by balancing workload, labor, automation, equipment, and capacity while ensuring decisions support total-building performance.

- Lead operations within a highly automated environment utilizing Goods-to-Person systems, warehouse management and execution systems, sortation technologies, and other material-handling automation.

- Partner with Engineering, Maintenance, Systems, Technology, Planning, and external providers to identify constraints, resolve operational and system issues, and improve performance.

- Utilize data, operational observations, Lean principles, Six Sigma methodologies, and structured problem-solving to eliminate waste, improve reliability, and deliver sustainable results.

- Lead workforce, capacity, and contingency planning efforts to support changing business demands, peak periods, promotional events, and operational disruptions.

- Establish effective communication routines that create visibility to risks, ensure alignment across shifts and functions, and support consistent execution.

- Build strong partnerships across Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Asset Protection, Engineering, Maintenance, Transportation, Technology, Merchandising, and Supply Chain functions.

- Communicate operational performance, risks, financial impacts, root causes, action plans, and strategic priorities to facility, network, and executive leadership.

- Promote a culture of safety, inclusion, respect, recognition, and development while building a strong pipeline of future leaders.

- Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills You Will Need

Operational & Fulfillment Leadership

- Extensive experience leading large-scale fulfillment, distribution, manufacturing, or logistics operations.

- Strong understanding of Direct-to-Consumer fulfillment and end-to-end operational flow.

- Experience operating in highly automated environments utilizing warehouse management, execution, robotics, sortation, conveyor, and Goods-to-Person technologies.

- Ability to evaluate operational dependencies, identify constraints, and optimize total-building performance.

Leadership & Business Acumen

- Proven ability to lead large organizations through leaders while building strong teams and succession pipelines.

- Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across operational and support functions.

- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, assess risk, make sound decisions, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong financial acumen with experience managing labor, productivity, budgets, cost controls, and operational performance metrics.

Continuous Improvement & Execution

- Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

- Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.

- Knowledge of workforce planning, capacity management, labor optimization, and throughput planning.

- Ability to adapt to evolving business requirements, technology changes, and volume fluctuations while maintaining operational excellence.

Who You Are

- A highly visible, engaged operational leader who is comfortable spending significant time within the operation and working directly with leaders and colleagues to understand opportunities and improve performance.

- A strong people developer who believes building leadership capability is essential to achieving sustainable operational results.

- An effective communicator who creates clarity, raises risks early, facilitates productive dialogue, and can confidently engage audiences ranging from frontline colleagues to senior executives.

- A systems thinker who understands how decisions within one area of a fulfillment center can impact inventory, automation, downstream capacity, customer service, and total-building performance.

- A leader who thrives in complex, highly automated, fast-paced environments and maintains composure and sound judgment when conditions change quickly.

- Demonstrates inclusive leadership by creating an environment where colleagues feel respected, valued, and empowered to contribute, develop, and grow.

- Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.

- 10+ years of progressive Supply Chain, Distribution, Fulfillment, or Operations leadership experience preferred , including significant leadership experience within large-scale Direct-to-Consumer or automated fulfillment operations.

- Demonstrated experience leading leaders and large teams across multiple shifts and functional areas in a complex operation.

- Able to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on facility and company needs.

- This position requires frequent walking and standing within a large fulfillment operation and may involve stooping, kneeling, crouching, climbing stairs or ladders, reaching, and lifting as required within the operational environment.

- Travel required up to 15%.

A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Manager, Sales & Customer Service ensures that the very best of Macy's is always on display. They see the store through the customers' eyes, leading initiatives to increase shopper loyalty while upholding Macy’s standards for customer service. Their passion for the perfect customer experience drives the service team to maintain a welcoming and ready sales floor. Macy’s fun and inclusive environment is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting with people and sharing knowledge and enthusiasm with the team through training and coaching.

What You Will Do

- Build a productive, enthusiastic team eager to engage with customers and create memorable shopping experiences

- Exceed sales goals by leading Macy's initiatives through coaching and recognition, optimizing productivity and efficiency

- Review and utilize Sales and Star Rewards data to recognize colleagues and develop strategies to improve results

- Manage selling support, including the stockroom, signing, equipment, and merchandising

- Support other operational areas such as OMNI, Style, and Asset Protection

- Conduct ongoing talent analysis of colleagues and establish career progression plans for key positions to retain top talent and reduce turnover

- Actively fill open positions, prioritizing internal colleagues in Customer Experience, Commission, and Specialized Selling areas

- Interview, hire, train, coach, develop, coordinate, evaluate, and discipline direct and indirect reports; manage the team to meet or exceed performance and behavioral expectations; address complaints and resolve problems with colleagues

- Work a flexible retail schedule, including days, evenings, holidays, and weekends

- Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Leadership and Team Building : Ability to build, lead, and motivate a productive, enthusiastic team

jobs.description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Leader, Prestige Selling at Macy’s, you play a key role in driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and supporting the success of our Beauty department. As the expert across multiple prestige cosmetics brands, you combine strong product knowledge, leadership skills, and a passion for beauty to create a high-performing and customer-focused environment.

In this role, you will lead by example - engaging with customers to deliver personalized service, coaching Beauty Advisors to meet performance goals, and executing events and brand strategies to grow market share. You will foster client loyalty, champion new product launches, and partner with vendors and store leadership to deliver consistent business results. Your ability to inspire others and stay on top of beauty trends makes you a trusted resource and a valued leader on the team.

How Our Prestige Selling Leaders Spend Their Day…

- Every day starts with a positive example . As a Prestige Selling Leaders, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team-wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends-so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.

- On the floor, you lead through action  - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.

- You help maintain a shoppable space   by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.

- You help the team Finish Strong  - by reminding them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.

- You know that service starts with each other . You model collaboration, honesty, and care-supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.

- And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day , take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found  here .

Who You Are and What You Will Do

- Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge

- Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up

- Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results

- Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement

- Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment

- Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes

- Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits

- Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner

- Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education

- Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail

- Available to work a flexible schedule including days, nights, weekends, and holidays

- 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred

- Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality

- Must be able to:

- Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors

- Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

- This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands

- Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level

- Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment

- Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

jobs.title: Beauty Sales Leader - Prestige Beauty, Millcreek Mall - Full Time
jobs.description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Leader, Prestige Selling at Macy’s, you play a key role in driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and supporting the success of our Beauty department. As the expert across multiple prestige cosmetics brands, you combine strong product knowledge, leadership skills, and a passion for beauty to create a high-performing and customer-focused environment.

In this role, you will lead by example - engaging with customers to deliver personalized service, coaching Beauty Advisors to meet performance goals, and executing events and brand strategies to grow market share. You will foster client loyalty, champion new product launches, and partner with vendors and store leadership to deliver consistent business results. Your ability to inspire others and stay on top of beauty trends makes you a trusted resource and a valued leader on the team.

How Our Prestige Selling Leaders Spend Their Day…

- Every day starts with a positive example . As a Prestige Selling Leaders, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team-wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends-so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.

- On the floor, you lead through action  - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.

- You help maintain a shoppable space   by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.

- You help the team Finish Strong  - by reminding them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.

- You know that service starts with each other . You model collaboration, honesty, and care-supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.

- And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day , take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found  here .

Who You Are and What You Will Do

- Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge

- Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up

- Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results

- Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement

- Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment

- Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes

- Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits

- Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner

- Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education

- Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail

- Available to work a flexible schedule including days, nights, weekends, and holidays

- 3–5 years of relevant retail, beauty, or leadership experience preferred

- Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality

- Must be able to:

- Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors

- Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

- This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands

- Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level

- Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment

- Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

- Merchandise discounts

- Performance-based incentives

- Annual merit review

- Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

The Senior Director, Brand Communications develops and executes integrated communications strategies spanning brand and product storytelling, campaigns, media relations, executive positioning, and recognition programs.
